d: Patna pramandal snatkottar/shikshak nirvachan kshetr se janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke mukhy pravakta aur purv mantri niraj kumar ki bari jit ki khabar milte hi navada jile ke nyu eriya men jashn ka mahaul ban gaya. jadyu neta rajesh kumar shri ke netritv men bari sankhya men samarthakon aur karyakartaon ne dhol-nagaron ki thap par jamkar aatishbaji ki aur ek-dusre ko mithaee khilakar khushiyan manaeen.
